annual.debt_basis: total tag (LongTermDebt, long-term incl. current maturities) + short-term borrowings (NotesPayableCurrent)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-03..2026-07-03

dividends_paid.basis: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-03..2026-07-03

legs.dividends_paid: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

notes: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

dividends_paid_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed dividends_paid figure (missing 2025-10-03, 2026-01-02, 2026-04-03, 2026-07-03) — the tag was never filed in any period, so the leg counts as zero
